findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the check-free sentence to be clear about which number is compared with 50.0%. Actual: when equity against all hands is above 50% but against callers is not (a case the rule allows), the text would read e.g. '...is 55.0% against all their hands and 40.0% against the hands that would call a bet. That is not above 50.0%...', where 'That' is ambiguous to a learner. The copy is exactly as approved in spec section 5, so this is a wording follow-up, not a defect.
